audience: Claims operations leaders deciding where to focus adjuster effort
sources: Claims administration: policies, claims, adjuster assignments and claim status

research.notes: Fictional worked example, not website research or an approved customer proposal.

proposal.title: Claims workload and settlement visibility
proposal.business_question: Which policy portfolios have the most open claims, and how much has been recorded in settlement payments overall?
proposal.audience_rationale: Claims leaders can prioritize an owned follow-up rather than inspect disconnected status and payment extracts.
proposal.decision: Record an adjuster follow-up for a selected portfolio and period.
assumptions: All policies, adjusters, claims and payments are synthetic; no policyholder or personal data.
Statuses and settlement amounts are illustrative, not inferred from a real insurer.
Claims and payments have different grains; aggregate each independently before comparison.
Opened date defines claim cohorts; status is current, not status as of the historical period.
Payments are ledger entries, not claim reserves, loss ratios or evidence of leakage.

metrics.name: open_claims
metrics.label: Currently open claims

metrics.name: settlement_cents
metrics.label: Recorded settlement payments
metrics.interpretation: Sum ledger entries in cents overall; does not measure reserves or loss ratios. Do not equate paid-date periods with opened-date cohorts.
